summary: Added Phase 0.2 discovery harness (mcp-acceptance/discovery.js) asserting the public 401 challenge and OAuth discovery contract (A1-A4), extended the two-host mock, and added verify-discovery.js; against current production it exits 1 with focused A1/A2/A4 failures and passing A3, capturing the baseline without modifying production code.
verification_commands: node --check mcp-acceptance/discovery.js && node --check mcp-acceptance/mock/server.js && node --check mcp-acceptance/verify-discovery.js
defects: mcp-server/src/gateway.rs:456-541 hard-codes lab loopback URL http://127.0.0.1:3001 in both 401 WWW-Authenticate builders instead of the configured public resource URL
mcp-server/src/gateway.rs:158-184 dispatches initialize to 400/-32601 protocol-dispatch error instead of a 401 OAuth challenge
issuer host cal.hajnal.space serves CommonCal SPA HTML at /.well-known/openid-configuration and /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server instead of authorization-server metadata
mcp-server/src/config.rs:327-365 OauthProtectedResourceMetadata carries a self-referential resource_metadata field (the document's own URL inside the document)
follow_up: stray node process holds port 3999 on this machine; verify-discovery.js defaults to 3998/3999 so pass --port to avoid the collision
Phase 0.3/0.4 harnesses can reuse the two-host mock topology (MOCK_PORT + MOCK_ISSUER_PORT) and the mode-tracking pattern
important_context: Phase 0.2 harness is mcp-acceptance/discovery.js; exit 1 against current production is the intentional baseline (A1/A2/A4 red, A3 green) and is the regression gate for later phases
deterministic production record written to $MCP_RECORD_DIR/mcp-acceptance-discovery.json with per-assertion pass/violation detail
expected public resource_metadata URL is derived as origin(MCP_URL) + /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource, mirroring mcp-server/src/config.rs logic
mock server now listens on two ports: MOCK_PORT (MCP host) and MOCK_ISSUER_PORT (default MOCK_PORT+1, issuer host)
